fusions.name: Stoop
fusions.desc: Drops on an enemy up to 6 tiles away and bites, which deals 26 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. The hit is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Carrion Callers
fusions.desc: Sends 3 ravens at once, spread apart out to 6 tiles; each deals 6 damage and has a 40% chance to leave its target [Marked] for 6 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Wing-Assisted Bound
fusions.desc: Carries you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Hollow Bones, Long Legs
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.
